import json
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier, SpecifierSet
s=SpecifierSet('>=1')
try:
 numeric=repr(Specifier('==1').__replace__(version=2))
except Exception as exc:
 numeric=type(exc).__name__
print(json.dumps({'equivalent_set_preserves_identity':s.__replace__(specifiers='>=1') is s, 'integer_version_result':numeric}))
